description: This PHP class 'DeployedMetaDataImplementation' handles loading, saving, and deploying view layout metadata for modules in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM. It includes methods for managing file locations, replacing variables, and merging layout definitions, indicating it's a core part of metadata management for module views.

classes.name: DeployedMetaDataImplementation
classes.description: Implements methods for managing deployed metadata layout files, including loading, saving, deploying, and filename generation, following a bridge pattern for handling module view layouts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the object, loading the appropriate layout definitions from various possible locations and merging definitions.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns the module name associated with this metadata implementation.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a given layout definition to the working metadata file, maintaining history.

methods.name: deploy
methods.description: Deploys the current layout definition by saving it into the main metadata location and clearing cache, removing temporary files.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Constructs the full path filename for a given view, module, package, and type location.

methods.name: replaceVariables
methods.description: Replaces template variables in layout definitions with module-specific values.

methods.name: getModuleDir
methods.description: Returns the directory name of the module.

methods.name: recursiveVariableReplace
methods.description: Recursively replaces variables in array keys and values.

methods.name: saveToFile
methods.description: Wrapper method to save layout definitions into a specified file.
